body.name: \widehat\tau_{\mathrm{med}}
body.construction: Partition \(O^{(n)}\) into five independent blocks whose sizes differ by at most one, compute \(\widehat\tau_{\lambda_n^{\star}}^{(j)}\) from def:clipped-score on block \(j\) using the same public functions, and set \(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{med}}=\operatorname{median}_{1\le j\le5}\widehat\tau_{\lambda_n^{\star}}^{(j)}\).
